'''''Ajuga iva''''', the '''southern bugle''', is a species of perennial herb in the family Lamiaceae. It have a self-supporting growth form and simple, broad leaves. Individuals can grow to 5 cm.<ref>{{Cite web|title=''Ajuga iva'' (L.) Schreb. - Encyclopedia of Life|url=https://eol.org/pages/5372930|access-date=2022-02-04|website=eol.org}}</ref> Subspecies include Ajuga iva subsp. iva and Ajuga iva subsp. pseudoiva.<ref>{{Cite web|title=MaltaWildPlants ''Ajuga iva'' subsp ''iva''|url=https://www.maltawildplants.com/LABT/Ajuga_iva_subsp_iva.php|website=Malta Wild Plants}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|last=Mifsud|first=Stephen|date=2002-08-23|title=''Ajuga iva'' subsp. ''pseudoiva'' (Yellow Southern Bugle) : MaltaWildPlants.com - the online Flora of the Maltese Islands.|url=https://www.maltawildplants.com/LABT/Ajuga_iva_subsp_pseudoiva.php|access-date=2022-02-07|website=www.maltawildplants.com|language=en-us}}</ref> The species is native to Europe, North Africa and parts of Western Asia including Turkey.<ref name=POWO/>
